short_description: All-task ACT with correct task-specific physical gripper conversion; official weights except fine-tuned Table. No environment modification.
data_source: Official RoboSynChallenge task-specific simulation datasets and public ACT checkpoints. Dataset revisions are in ten_task_data_inventory.json. Submitted Table weights were fine-tuned from the official Table checkpoint using 200 demo episodes, 50 validation episodes, seed 20261012, lr 1e-6, batch 8, 2000 steps, selected step 1500; original normalization tensors preserved. The other nine submitted weights are unchanged official public ACT models.
run_and_dependency_notes: Use an official working RoboSynChallenge/EmbodiChain/DexSim Linux Python 3.11 environment. Tested: PyTorch 2.7.1+cu128, torchvision 0.22.1, LeRobot 0.3.3 at b883328e6c95681ca90a18b102e4ae5e1f91e2bf, evaluator ecbf88ae26bbd8e369eba868e23354c8f64e083f, EmbodiChain 89c14da8d0221dc4ee2a4a3e0ba1078b16d447bd, DexSim 0.4.3. Install ACT package pins per README, then bash setup.sh. All tasks: bash eval.sh TASK random 0. Pytorch device cuda, logical GPU 0, original action chunk/execution length 50, inherited CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES preserved. Exact checkpoint revisions/subdirectories are in task_mapping.json. Eight normalized-action tasks map gripper indices 6/13 to physical action-space limits once; Table already uses physical metres and ClickBell has fixed-zero actions. No environment palette/pose changes are included. Detailed gripper tracing is disabled. This request covers all ten tasks.
